# Excerpt of the Pi live writer (not in git) as it stood after the
# 2026-10-07 shorts-prune hotfix. Fixture for youtube_groom_shorts.patch_writer_source.
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any


# shorts-prune hotfix 2026-10-07: prune any Short already on the playlist.
SHORTS_PRUNE_MIN_SEC = 60
SHORTS_PRUNE_MAX_SEC = 180


def _shorts_url_status(video_id: str) -> int | None:
    """No-redirect GET of youtube.com/shorts/<id>. 200 = Short, 303 to /watch = not."""
    import urllib.error
    import urllib.request

    class _NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
        def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
            return None

    req = urllib.request.Request(f"https://www.youtube.com/shorts/{video_id}", method="GET")
    try:
        resp = urllib.request.build_opener(_NoRedirect).open(req, timeout=5)
        return int(resp.getcode())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        if exc.code == 303 and "/watch" not in str(exc.headers.get("Location") or ""):
            return None
        return int(exc.code)
    except Exception:
        return None


def _shorts_prune_reason(item: dict[str, Any], video: dict[str, Any], cache: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    dur = item.get("duration_sec")
    if isinstance(dur, int) and not isinstance(dur, bool) and 0 < dur < SHORTS_PRUNE_MIN_SEC:
        return "short<60s"
    vs = video.get("snippet") or {}
    parts = [item.get("title") or "", item.get("description") or ""]
    parts.extend(str(t) for t in (vs.get("tags") or []))
    if re.search(r"#shorts?\b", "\n".join(parts), re.I):
        return "short-flagged"
    if isinstance(dur, int) and not isinstance(dur, bool) and SHORTS_PRUNE_MIN_SEC <= dur <= SHORTS_PRUNE_MAX_SEC:
        vid = item.get("video_id") or ""
        if not vid:
            return ""
        if vid not in cache:
            status = _shorts_url_status(vid)
            if status not in (200, 303):
                return ""  # probe error: fail open, retry next tick
            cache[vid] = status == 200
        return "short-url" if cache[vid] else ""
    return ""


def _groom_after_gate(args, state, quota):
    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    skipped_add: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    yt = log = None
    if True:
        try:
            from youtube_groom_supply import filter_longform

            candidates, longform_skipped = filter_longform(candidates, yt, log)
            skipped_add.extend(longform_skipped)
        except Exception as exc:
            reraise_if_quota(exc)
            log.warning("longform filter failed")
            kept_longform = []
            for c in candidates:
                dur = c.get("duration_sec")
                blob = f"{c.get('title') or ''} {c.get('description') or ''}".lower()
                flagged = "#short" in blob or "/shorts/" in blob
                known_long = (
                    isinstance(dur, int)
                    and not isinstance(dur, bool)
                    and dur >= 60
                    and not flagged
                )
                if known_long:
                    kept_longform.append(c)
                else:
                    why = "short<60s" if isinstance(dur, int) and not isinstance(dur, bool) and 0 < dur < 60 else "duration-unknown"
                    if flagged and not (isinstance(dur, int) and not isinstance(dur, bool) and 0 < dur < 60):
                        why = "short-flagged"
                    skipped_add.append(
                        {
                            "video_id": c.get("video_id") or "",
                            "title": c.get("title") or "",
                            "why": why,
                        }
                    )
            candidates = kept_longform
        ranked_add = []
    return candidates


def reraise_if_quota(exc):
    return None
